title: Factions: renown, Favor and faction prices
summary: DMs can add the guilds, cults and houses that judge the party. Each character earns renown with a faction, shown on a karma-style meter from Vilified to Idolized, and the party's attitude changes prices at the shops the faction controls.
items: A faction controls shops, or whole places and every shop in them. The party's attitude is the middle renown of the characters travelling with the party, and its tier makes those shops cheaper or dearer, with prices per tier the DM can change for each faction and shop.
Raising renown earns Favor automatically, and the DM can grant Favor directly. Losing renown never takes Favor away.
Why this price? and Why this payout? show each faction's effect by name, and the purchase or sale moves exactly that total.

Players see only the factions the DM reveals, with their own renown and Favor and the party's attitude, never another character's standing. A hidden faction still changes prices and shows as "Local standing".
